scope: Offline read-only EV90 preflight; no Q/EV88 candidate read, no solver, no candidate output.

formula_contract.above_field: max at vertices of positive-area ODOL-face/native-triangle intersection of (z_face - nominal_P_or_F) > tolerance
formula_contract.buried_unknown_exception: max over same intersection vertices of (z_face - z_ground_at_float32_lower_envelope) <= 0.0; terrain interpolation uses the exact NW-SE native triangle
formula_contract.lower_envelope_implication: inside a native triangle, barycentric weights are nonnegative; if each allowed H vertex is >= L32 and face <= ground(L32) everywhere on the overlap, face remains buried for every allowed H
formula_contract.crossing_edge: g_w=h_w-level_w<0<g_d=h_d-level_d; t0=-g_w/(g_d-g_w); require t in [max(0,t0-1/edge_length), min(1,t0+1/edge_length)]; convert back with g_d=g_w*(1-1/t)
formula_contract.height_bounds: lower=max(EV79-2, min(EV79,1.8), min(EV79,max(P,F,SEA)+1e-4)); upper=min(EV79+2,B+0.5); round inward to float32 before intersecting crossings
formula_contract.box_test: per-axis interval possibility only; each node is treated independently and all non-scalar/global/shape constraints are omitted, so infeasibility is decisive but feasibility is optimistic

limitations: No terrain/render engine or wave envelope; the test is static compiled ODOL triangle height against nominal P/F fields.
Buried faces are included: current terrain height is not used to cull model faces.
The source 0WZD transforms are linked by B deploy/PBO hashes; transforms are not parsed from the compiled OPRW payload.
The focal box-feasibility calculation is optimistic and separable; it is a bound-only interval test, not a coupled terrain solve or proof that other geometry gates pass.
No P/F values are imputed. P9 NaN cells and partial-F cells are frozen; unknown-face exceptions use the float32 lower-ground envelope.
